studies.Population: Postmenopausal women aged 50–79 years in the Women's Health Initiative Observational Study
studies.Smoking Status: Never, past, or current smoker; smoking included in adjusted models
studies.Ethnicity Basis: Default: no protocol-mapped specific country or population was established
studies.Ethnicity Supporting Text: Women between the ages of 50 and 79 yr were enrolled.
studies.Reference: Association of Artificially Sweetened Beverage Consumption and Urinary Tract Cancers in the Women's Health Initiative Observational Study.
studies.Authors: Ringel NE, Hovey KM, Andrews CA, Mossavar-Rahmani Y, Shadyab AH, Snetselaar LG, Howard BV, Iglesia CB
studies.Timing: Exposure assessed at year 3; incident cancers followed through February 28, 2020
studies.comparison_type: 1–6 artificially sweetened beverage servings per week versus never or fewer than 1 serving per week
studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: The frequency of artificially sweetened beverage consumption was categorized

sample_size.excerpt: In this secondary analysis of the Women’s Health Initiative Observational Study that included 80 388 postmenopausal women, higher consumption of artificially sweetened beverages was associated with a higher risk of kidney cancer.

effect_size.excerpt: Cox regression models showed that frequent artificially sweetened beverage consumption was associated with a higher risk of kidney cancer (adjusted hazard ratio 1.34, 95% confidence interval 1.03-1.75).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Cox regression models showed that frequent artificially sweetened beverage consumption was associated with a higher risk of kidney cancer (adjusted hazard ratio 1.34, 95% confidence interval 1.03-1.75).

comparison.excerpt: rare artificially sweetened beverage consumption (never to fewer than one serving per week), frequent consumption (one to six servings per week)

design.excerpt: This was a secondary analysis of data from the Women's Health Initiative Observational Study, a multicenter longitudinal prospective study

timing.excerpt: a mean follow-up time of 13.5 yr

continent.excerpt: Women were identified at 40 clinical centers across the USA

ethnicity.excerpt: Women between the ages of 50 and 79 yr were enrolled.
